$comment: Template deployment profile. Copy it, rename it after your deployment, and fill in your own values - or supply the whole thing as the DEPLOY_PROFILE_JSON repository variable and commit nothing. See docs/deployment.md.
name: example

mail.$comment: Route53 zone for mailDomain IN THIS ACCOUNT. Empty means the domain is hosted elsewhere, so MX, DKIM and the SES identity are a manual bootstrap. Set it and the stack owns all three.

brand.$comment: Optional. Paths relative to the repo root, copied into the web build at deploy time. Omit both, as here, and the app uses its own neutral mark.

web.$comment: Optional. Omit the whole block to be served on the CloudFront domain instead. The zone must be one this account can write to.

environments.$comment: One entry per environment. Each may override mailDomains, web, mail, api and senderLocalPart; anything absent comes from the top level, so a single environment is an empty object. No two environments may claim the same mail domain. See docs/deployment.md.
